articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
The lift at Derker tram stop is out of service until further notice, as of 1:26pm on 11 August 2026. This disruption affects passengers using the tram stop for travel towards Manchester and Rochdale.

Customers travelling towards Manchester can access the platform via a ramp from Cromford Street. For those travelling away from Manchester, step-free access is available via a ramp from Cromford Street, followed by a track crossing to reach the Rochdale bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has advised passengers to plan their journeys accordingly and apologised for any inconvenience caused by the lift's unavailability.
